items.title: How tokenization benefits SpaceX stock 'without taking crypto risk'
items.summary: Dialectic founder Ryan Zurrer comes on Market Catalysts to discuss the opportunities that tokenized assets present compared to traditional stocks, and the advantages this is giving companies like Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX).

items.title: Nvidia crushed earnings but one analyst is rating it a "sell"
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered a strong quarter, beating Wall Street expectations and offering a stronger-than-expected outlook. But with the AI trade already priced for near-perfection, even another blowout may not be enough to move investors.  Seaport Research Partners senior analyst Jay Goldberg joins Josh Lipton on Asking for a Trend to explain why Nvidia’s impressive results could ultimately be a “nobody is going to care” moment for the stock.

items.title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: When Will the AI Bubble Burst? History Says Not Anytime Soon.
items.summary: When it comes to a capital spending bubble, the trick isn’t dancing when the music is playing, but knowing when it’s time to sit down.  The scale of AI capital expenditures has been astounding.  Since the start of 2024, roughly $500 billion has been spent on chips, $350 billion on power infrastructure, $200 billion on construction, and $100 billion on networking.
